question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: **

Not only the minister but also the bureaucrats (1)/ has been accused of manipulating (2)/ the data presented in the economic survey (3)/ to align with political interests. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. 'has been accused' contains the error .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the correlative conjunction **"Not only... but also."** When this conjunction is used, the verb must agree with the subject closest to it.
 
• Here, the subject closest to the verb "has been accused" is "bureaucrats," which is plural.
 
• Therefore, the verb should be "have been accused" instead of "has been accused."

Correct sentence: *Not only the minister but also the bureaucrats **have been accused** of manipulating the data presented in the economic survey to align with political interests.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:** The verb must always agree in number with the subject.
 
• **Correlative Conjunctions:** When using "Not only... but also," the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.
 
• **Plural Subjects:** Words like "bureaucrats" take plural verbs such as "have."
